description: National electricity consumption 2005 - 2020 is a dataset listed in Peclet Data Portal open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by NEM. This dataset, extract from the NEM open data platform, shows evolution of national electricity consumption by electricity source (coal, solar, wind, hydro etc.) for the single from of April from 2005 to 2020. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under Energy, Utilities. Its keywords are energy, electricity, CO2, environment, sustainability. The portal shows 16 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2020-05-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-peclet-com-au-portal.
